hero.title: Build and maintain custom boxes for fast scoped auto-builds.
hero.copy: Organize up to {{characterCount}} local characters into practical groups you can reuse in the Auto Team Builder.

list.title: Your saved boxes
list.copy: Each box can contain any mix of characters and the same character can live in multiple boxes.

ladder.title: What this box can field
ladder.copy: A short list of well-known content, and whether this box holds enough characters to field a team for it. It is about the box, not about clearing: how hard something is to beat is not in the app data.
ladder.provisional: The numbers for this one are a starting point, not a confirmed requirement.
ladder.note: Content names come from the app data and are checked against it on every build, so a renamed stage shows up as a problem instead of sitting here quietly. The requirements beside them are set by hand, by the person who maintains the app, and dated.

editor.buildFromBoxLabel: What can I build with this box?

buildFromBoxSupport.ready: Opens Auto Team Builder with only these {{count}} characters available.
buildFromBoxSupport.tooSmall: Add {{count}} more characters - a crew needs five different ones.

editor.title: Selected box
editor.copy: Search the roster and add or remove characters from this box. Current count: {{count}}.
editor.addFavoritesCopy: Merge every favorited character you have not already placed in this box.
editor.selectAllFilteredCopy: Add every character matching the active filters, including results not loaded yet.
editor.nameRequired: A box name is required before it can be saved.

cost.invalidRange: Cost from cannot be greater than Cost to.

support.label: Support Ability filters
support.support: {{count}} selected effects. Results must match every selected effect.

noBoxes.title: No boxes yet
noBoxes.copy: Create your first box to start grouping characters for targeted builds.

selectBox.title: Select a box
selectBox.copy: Pick a box from the list to rename it and manage its character roster.

noCharacters.emptyBox: {{name}} has no characters yet, so "Already in box" shows nothing. Set Membership back to "All membership states", or add characters to the box.
noCharacters.noFavorites: You have no favorites yet, so "Favorites only" shows nothing. Set Favorites back to "All characters".
noCharacters.title: No characters found
noCharacters.copy: No character matches the current search and filters.
